acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Demons family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Archfiend, T4, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Soul-Chain Hierarchy Marshal (Champion) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two fire construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: A twice-human-height Demon with obsidian armor fused to visible hide, wings of source-native black smoke supported by membrane spars, a crown of many horns, and three distinct chains of bound souls.

Signature mechanic: Black Chain of Office: the Archfiend's crown of horns selects one of three soul chains. The Pest chain transfers stolen brands, the Charge chain links Fiend stamp lines, and the Sentence chain lets a Hellknight move its square once. Wings of source-native black smoke spread only to screen the active chain. Its fused obsidian armor ring opens under load.
battlefieldDuty: Link brands, charge lines, and sentence cells into a command formation through separate bound-soul chains, each attached to one breakable fused-armor ring.
constructionDimensions: Fire affinity adds an engineered overfire system beyond native infernal heat: ceramic secondary chambers, oxygen-bellows wing ribs, white-hot brand inlays, fuel cages on armor or throne, and quenched obsidian vents preserve hide and anatomy.

Actions follow a distinct charge-combust-purge cycle through opening intake plates, expanding bellows membranes, directional overfire jets, exhaust smoke, and a visibly dark cooling chamber after each empowered command.
counterplay: Trace the taut chain past the smoke screen, resolve the familiar lower-form tell, and strike the opened armor ring; each broken ring dismisses its soul chain and simplifies the formation. Affinity signal: The secondary chamber purges white to black and its intake plate stays open after overfire; breaking the intake prevents recharge without extinguishing the Demon's family-native core.
forbiddenTreatments: Palette-only fire treatment or extra orange applied to the family-native ember palette
Glow-only fire treatment without a secondary chamber, oxygen route, and purge cycle
More native magma or larger flames with no distinct affinity construction
Fire that erases horn, hide, hoof, membrane, armor, brand, or hierarchy readability
identityInvariants: A horned head, broadening shoulders, digitigrade or hooved legs, long tail, claws, and bat-like wing membranes remain legible from cat-sized pest to enthroned sovereign.
Blood red or ashen hide, char black, source-native ember orange, molten yellow, and obsidian preserve an infernal body whose internal fire is explained anatomy rather than affinity by default.
Charred hide, obsidian, blackened iron, native molten rock, smoke, and bat membrane retain distinct surfaces instead of collapsing into a generic flame silhouette.
Brands, infernal sigils, chains, spiked black armor, skull motifs, and horn arrangements communicate authored rank and command routes without implying a universal moral taxonomy.

Horn count, wing authority, and the proportion of source-native fire or obsidian increase with rank, but every form preserves visible hide, joints, brand routes, and an interruptible hierarchy anchor.
telegraph: One horn-crown branch hooks downward, a single soul chain straightens toward its lower form, black-smoke wings part around that route, and the matching armor ring opens.
